duckdb.source_projection:
SELECT
  "FIRST_NAME" AS "first_name",
  "LAST_NAME" AS "last_name",
  "MOBILE" AS "mobile",
  "LANDLINE" AS "landline",
  "VIP" AS "vip",
  "FULL_ADDRESS" AS "full_address",
  CAST("AMOUNT" AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS "amount",
  CAST(SUBSTRING(TRIM("COUNTRY"), 1, 2) AS TEXT(2)) AS "country_code",
  SHA256(CAST("EMAIL" AS TEXT)) AS "email",
  "STATUS" AS "status_code",
  CAST("CREATED" AS DATE) AS "created_on",
  CAST((
    TRIM(NULLIF("FIRST_NAME", '')) || ' ' || TRIM(NULLIF("LAST_NAME", ''))
  ) AS TEXT(160)) AS "full_name",
  COALESCE("MOBILE", "LANDLINE") AS "contact_phone",
  CAST(CASE
    WHEN "STATUS" = 'A'
    THEN 'active'
    WHEN "STATUS" = 'C'
    THEN 'closed'
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS TEXT(20)) AS "status_label",
  CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS "loaded_at",
  CAST(LIST_EXTRACT(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL("FULL_ADDRESS", '(.*?)(?:,\ |$)'), 1) AS TEXT(120)) AS "street",
  CAST(LIST_EXTRACT(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL("FULL_ADDRESS", '(?:,\ ){1}(.*?)(?:,\ |$)'), 1) AS TEXT(80)) AS "city",
  CASE
    WHEN (
      TRUNC((
        LENGTH("FULL_ADDRESS") - LENGTH(REPLACE("FULL_ADDRESS", ', ', ''))
      ) / 2) + 1
    ) > 2
    THEN 1
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "__q_customer-table_extra_parts"
FROM "SHOP"."CUSTOMER" AS "t0"
WHERE
  (
    "STATUS" <> 'X' AND (
      "CREATED" >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' OR "VIP" = 'Y'
    )
  )

  OR "email" = ''
  OR "status_code" = ''
  OR "full_name" = ''
  OR "contact_phone" = ''
  OR "status_label" = ''
  OR "street" = ''
  OR "city" = ''

WHERE

assumptions: cast to numeric(12,2) with onOverflow=quarantine is enforced by the validation contract; the transform itself cannot route rows
column-split on FULL_ADDRESS is deterministic for the first 2 parts; parts beyond the declared targets have nowhere to go, which is why onExtraParts exists
column-split onExtraParts=quarantine: a row with more than 2 delimited parts raises __q_customer-table_extra_parts; the extra parts have no target column so they would otherwise disappear silently
concat is rendered as Oracle `||`, which treats a NULL operand as an empty string rather than propagating NULL
mask strategy=hash is rendered as Oracle STANDARD_HASH(expr, 'SHA256'); the digest is not reversible, which is the point of masking but is irreversible

duckdb.source_projection:
SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    "NARRATIVE" AS "narrative",
    "ORDER_DATE" AS "order_date",
    "SHOP.BRANCH" AS "shop.branch",
    "BRANCH_CODE" AS "branch_code",
    COALESCE("CURRENCY", 'EUR') AS "currency",
    (
      "SHIP_DATE" + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    ) AS "ship_date",
    CASE WHEN AMOUNT > 1000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS "priority",
    CAST("AMOUNT" AS DECIMAL(14, 4)) AS "amount",
    CAST('shop-eu' AS TEXT(10)) AS "tenant_id",
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN "lk1"."__lk1_n" > 1
      THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      ELSE COALESCE("lk1"."__lk1_v0", 'UNKNOWN')
    END AS TEXT(80)) AS "branch_name"
  FROM "SHOP"."ORDERS" AS "t0"
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      "CODE" AS "__lk1_k0",
      MAX("NAME") AS "__lk1_v0",
      COUNT(*) AS "__lk1_n"
    FROM "SHOP"."BRANCH"
    GROUP BY
      "CODE"
  ) AS "lk1"
    ON "BRANCH_CODE" = "lk1"."__lk1_k0"
) AS "__transformed"
WHERE
  (
    "__transformed"."ship_date" >= "__transformed"."order_date"
    OR "__transformed"."ship_date" IS NULL
  )
